subject: Error: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source

messages.author: 95a3283fdeca986b
messages.subject: Error: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source
parts:
Hi, I tried to deploy my App but failed with this message:
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 489788038 error: Unhandled Exception: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source.

I checked all the packages I used in my App and found out two of them("genetics" and "LDheatmap") was causing the error.

How could I solve problem?

Thanks in advance.

Taerim Lee

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Error: Repository must be specified for Bioconductor package source
parts:
Where do those packages come from? What is the output of rsconnect::appDependencies()?

shinyapps.io supports packages from CRAN, GitHub and BioConductor.

On Wednesday, September 27, 2017 at 6:59:21 AM UTC-4, 이태림 wrote:
